text: 《行动方案》坚持目标导向、问题导向，针对智能家居消费的增长点及存在的堵点卡点，提出扩大优质智能家居供给、完善智能家居标准体系、优化社区便民服务等七条举措，重点突出以下四个方面：一是坚持供需协同发力。二是打造多元融合生态。三是精准服务不同群体。四是打通便民服务链条。下一步，商务部将会同相关部门落实落细各项工作举措，推动相关政策尽快落地见效，带动更多智能家居产品走入百姓家庭，更好满足人民美好生活需要。
text_en: The Action Plan adheres to a goal-oriented and problem-oriented approach, and in response to the growth points and existing bottlenecks and obstacles in smart home consumption, proposes seven measures including expanding the supply of high-quality smart homes, improving the smart home standards system, and optimizing community convenience services, with emphasis on the following four aspects: First, adhere to coordinated efforts on both the supply and demand sides. Second, create a diversified and integrated ecosystem. Third, provide precise services for different groups. Fourth, open up the convenience service chain. Next, the Ministry of Commerce will work with relevant departments to implement all work measures in detail, promote the early implementation and effectiveness of relevant policies, bring more smart home products into ordinary households, and better meet the people's needs for a better life.
